sourceFile: 025.1 MSU-L20S15-07 Result check NTI lot test New Bond SJ4774 and VE562850- 2025.06.17_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft identifies a comparable Normal versus SJ4774/VE562850 acoustic lot test but the generated grouping and metrics are not reliable.
issues: Review title is a nonsemantic extracted row.
Changed factor uses filename instead of tested bond/lot conditions.
Baseline and changed conditions are marked unclear despite rows naming Normal, SJ4774, and VE562850.
Outcomes mix valid graph summaries with misparsed raw numeric rows.
Some cited comparison rows are not shown in context and are weak for final evidence.
requiredUserQuestions: Confirm SJ4774 and VE562850 are the new bond lot conditions compared with Normal.
correctionPlan: Set title to NTI lot/New Bond acoustic result check for MSU-L20S15-07.
Define baseline as Normal and changed conditions as SJ4774 and VE562850; keep STD as reference only.
Use GRAPH rows 2-11 for summarized SPL, Fo, and THD comparisons.
Use RAW DATA rows 3, 7, 8 and section headers only to support sample grouping.
Remove misparsed subresults whose conditions are numeric cell values rather than metrics.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist but are insufficiently targeted; final evidence needs header plus condition summary rows.
